The blind R reference does not touch schedule-template.ts, yet the budget-template test passes: the template walks occurrences with getNextDate(..., true), which the reference changed. So the template's test cannot show a missed template copy independently of the next-date site, and the earlier check (one template copy updated, the other not) no longer describes a tree a reference produces. The check now asks what the merged next-date consumer credits: it must be updated with the full reference, and not updated when the next-date site (getNextDate) is left as it was, whether or not the template's own copies are updated.
